title: Kenyan Fried Bananas
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Fried Bananas — ripe bananas pan-fried in butter with brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla until caramelised and golden. Ready in 10 minutes and completely irresistible — the simplest, most satisfying Kenyan dessert.
longDesc: Fried bananas are the dessert that requires almost nothing to be extraordinary — just ripe bananas, butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a hot pan for a few minutes. The banana caramelises in the butter and sugar, becoming golden and sticky, sweet and aromatic, soft within and slightly crisp at the edges. It is the dessert that uses up nearly-overripe bananas and turns them into something celebratory.
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas — peeled and halved lengthwise
Juice of half a lime — optional

substitutions.alternative: Coconut oil — gives a tropical character

steps: Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add bananas cut-side down. Cook without moving for 2—3 minutes until golden and caramelised.
Sprinkle brown sugar, cinnamon, salt, and vanilla over the bananas.
Flip carefully. Cook the other side for 1—2 minutes.
Add lime juice if using. Swirl the pan.
chefTips: Use very ripe bananas — the more ripe, the sweeter and more flavourful.
Do not move the bananas during the first 2—3 minutes — let the caramelisation develop undisturbed.
Serve immediately — fried bananas are best eaten straight from the pan.
commonMistakes: Under-ripe bananas — starchy and lacking sweetness.
Moving the bananas too early — prevents caramelisation.
Waiting too long to serve — they become soft and lose their structure.
cookingScience: The natural sugars in ripe bananas (primarily sucrose, fructose, and glucose) caramelise rapidly when they contact the hot butter, creating the golden, caramelised surface. Very ripe bananas have a higher sugar content and lower starch content, producing deeper caramelisation and sweeter flavour.
sustainabilityTips: Perfect use for overripe bananas that would otherwise be discarded.
Kenya is a significant banana producer — buying local supports farmers.
healthBenefits: Bananas are rich in potassium and vitamin B6.
Provide quick energy from natural fruit sugars.
Ripe bananas are easier to digest than unripe.
culturalNote: Fried bananas are one of the great simple pleasures of Kenyan home cooking — transforming overripe bananas into something golden and celebratory in minutes. Kenya's abundance of bananas makes this one of the most accessible and beloved home desserts.
